name: Court ceasefire rulings on the 15 km Japan map: the Ashikaga human petitions through EXECUTE_SCRIPT and pays Favor/Gold/Legitimacy each time. Turn 1: a war forced between two houses with the same city count is petitioned; the AI accepts, and at turn 2 peace is made at once with MakePeaceWith(b, true) (inside the 10-turn minimum war length) with a 30-turn truce. Turn 2: Ouchi-Otomo (R01) is petitioned and Ouchi refuses; at turn 13 (past the 10-turn minimum peace length) a war forced inside the truce is undone at turn 14
